ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 40% high-intensity (white) and 60% low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity (white) mottling concentrated on the outer distal regions of both lobes, transitioning to low-intensity (black) dominance toward the center and base.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a central pixel-angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular micro-serration with peak amplitudes of 5-15 pixels; presence of a deep, distinct U-shaped notch on the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curvature extending from the central notch to the distal lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular ocelli-like patterns (dark centers with high-intensity white rings) mid-lobe; dense, high-intensity textured clusters localized at the distal extreme of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-intensity linear streaks crossing the dark pigmentation, most notably a series of diagonal lines on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized biological encrustations (barnacles) at the distal tips; irregular notches along the trailing edge boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct concentric double-ring pixel pattern located on the mid-left lobe surface.
